Slide specimen

Every slide type of the h&w slide engine, one example each, then the content blocks a content slide is built from, as they look in a printed deck. All content is made up. Click a name to see its slide at 1440 px.

Opens from a checkout of the slides repository after bun install, or at http://slides.localhost with bun run dev: fonts and logos load from node_modules/@hackersandwizards/brand. Built by bun run specimen from specimen/slide-catalogue.ts.
